text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Helder Marques, an HIV-positive Portuguese immigrant in Canada who is threatened with deportation, goes to court today in Toronto. His deportation may be delayed.
- Cimpor has spent 62 billion escudos to acquire two cement manufacturers in Brazil
- Hundreds of clients of Banco Portugues do Atlantico had access to accounts that were not their own yesterday due to a computing fault.
- Last Friday majority shareholders of VA Controlo, holding company of ceramics producer Vista Alegre, signed an accord with minority shareholders with a view to buying 90 percent of the holding.
